requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required Courses
requirements.sourceText: Required Courses: MEC 260 - Engineering Statics 3 credits; MEC 262 - Engineering Dynamics 3 credits; MEC 301 - Thermodynamics 3 credits; MEC 363 - Mechanics of Solids 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Elective Courses (Choose 2)

rule.manualCheck: Other MEC electives not listed here require the approval of the undergraduate program director; the student should consult the program director before registering for elective courses.

requirements.sourceText: Elective Courses (Choose 2): MEC 305 - Heat and Mass Transfer 3 credits; MEC 310 - Introduction to Machine Design 3 credits; MEC 320 - Numerical Methods in Engineering Design and Analysis 3 credits; MEC 325 - Manufacturing Processes 3 credits; MEC 364 - Introduction to Fluid Mechanics 3 credits; MEC 393 - Engineering Fluid Mechanics 3 credits; MEC 398 - Thermodynamics II 3 credits; MEC 402 - Mechanical Vibrations 3 credits; MEC 411 - Control System Analysis and Design 4 credits; MEC 455 - Applied Stress Analysis 3 credits. Note: Other MEC electives require the approval of the undergraduate program director.

requirements.label: total-credits
requirements.title: Total minor credits

rule.text: Completion of the minor requires 18-20 credits, of which 12-13 are from required courses and 6-7 from electives.
rule.reason: A program-wide credit range that no rule type covers; it is only partly implied by the two requirement groups.

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 18-20 credits, of which 12-13 are from required courses and 6-7 from electives.

policies.sourceText: All courses must be taken for a letter grade
a g.p.a. of 2.00 or higher is required for the six courses that constitute the minor.

notes.text: Entry into this minor presupposes a background in mathematics and physics, represented by the prerequisite requirements for the courses listed below.
A student who wishes to pursue this minor should consult with the undergraduate program director in the Department of Mechanical Engineering before registering for the elective courses.
No course substitutions or transfer courses are permitted for the MEC minor, i.e. students must take the MEC offering of these courses.
